title: Performance Monitoring
definition: Continuously tracking frontend metrics (API latency, render times, memory leaks) in production. Tools like Datadog or Sentry APM visualize these metrics on dashboards and trigger alerts if performance degrades.
simpleExplanation: A dashboard full of graphs that flashes red if your API suddenly starts taking 5 seconds to load.

basic: What is the core concept of Performance Monitoring?

trick: Can Performance Monitoring be fully automated?

answers.question: Define Performance Monitoring.
answers.answer: Performance Monitoring is a key non-functional requirement for robust frontend systems.
